live_fusion.replacement_observation: WP804 already enforces exact-goal output only under unique declared public evidence and otherwise expects ABSTAIN.
live_fusion.remaining_gap: Binary ABSTAIN discards which candidate goals remain publicly compatible; current WP802 probes from a predeclared policy rather than from that ambiguity structure.
live_fusion.reuse_discovery: Existing Hyperposition, DiscriminatorCandidate and Epistemic Action Selection already implement the generic unresolved-alternative and information-gain machinery, so a new goal-hypothesis subsystem would be redundant.
live_fusion.parallel_movement: F2 main moved repeatedly during this run, including concurrent WP803/WP807 Trigger-4/6 work. This fusion is bound to exact source blobs and observed heads rather than assuming a stationary main.

architecture_delta.shape: Derive the public-compatible goal set using only WP804-visible inputs; for cardinality >1, project each compatible candidate into existing Hyperposition Alternatives with exact public provenance; use existing DiscriminatorCandidate and Epistemic Action Selection for candidate information-seeking; optionally terminate through existing Active Sensing. No new persistent goal state.
architecture_delta.authority: Projection/candidate only; no world-truth, goal-adoption, canonical-state, effect or completion authority.
architecture_delta.expected_token_effect: No additional model call required; typed deterministic bridge should add near-zero model-token consumption if validated.
architecture_delta.expected_resource_effect: Linear set/adaptor work in candidate-goal count; unmeasured until ablation.

contradictions.claim: Non-identifiable goal inference needs a new ambiguity representation.
contradictions.counterevidence: Hyperposition already is the generic unresolved-alternative representation.
contradictions.resolution: Do not add another representation; test a thin adapter into Hyperposition.

contradictions.claim: ABSTAIN alone is sufficient for downstream information-seeking.
contradictions.counterevidence: Goal-recognition literature treats sets of compatible goals as meaningful and active goal recognition uses actions/sensing to reduce that set; F2 WP802 does not yet bind probe choice to goal-set structure.

counterhypothesis: The candidate set carries no extra decision-relevant information because equivalent uncertainty is already derivable elsewhere or direct ObservationView-to-probe policies perform equally well with less state plumbing.
falsifier: Matched microworld cases with identical initial WP804 ABSTAIN but different public-compatible goal sets and different uniquely useful probe actions. Under equal public evidence/action budget, compare binary-ABSTAIN baseline against the thin Hyperposition adapter. Reject if no probe-selection/downstream-accuracy gain or if equivalent state is already produced by an admitted path.
next_exact_gate: Acquire a nonduplicate Trigger-6 E4 claim for the matched goal-ambiguity-to-Hyperposition ablation, unless a newer architecture change or active claim makes the objective stale/owned.
